title: Dong2023 – 59-subject 40-class SSVEP dataset
description: An 8-channel EEG dataset from 59 healthy adolescents (aged 10-16) who performed a 40-target SSVEP-based brain-computer interface task. The task used joint frequency and phase modulation (JFPM) with stimulation frequencies of 8.0-15.8 Hz. Data were collected at the Suzhou Junior Competition of BCI Olympics 2022 and are provided as epoched trials, 4 blocks of 40 trials per subject. The dataset supports benchmarking of SSVEP classification and spatial-filtering methods.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz with a NeuSenW (Neuracle) amplifier using 8 semi-dry pre-gelled electrodes over the occipital region (POz, PO3, PO4, PO7, PO8, Oz, O1, O2), referenced to Fp1, then downsampled to 250 Hz. Each trial consisted of a 1 s cue, 4 s JFPM visual flicker stimulation on a 4x10 matrix layout, and 1 s feedback. Each subject completed 4 blocks of 40 trials, and data are epoched from 0.5 s before to 0.5 s after stimulation.
